Snake Measurer 1.6.0 · 2026-06-19

The update that turned Snake Measurer from a ruler into a place where every snake's story lives.

Auto-detect (beta). Take a photo and the reference and the snake are found for you. Any point can still be adjusted.

Animal profiles. Every snake gets its own profile with a photo, species and age. Tap an animal to open its full measurement history.

Growth charts. Watch each snake grow, compare them with each other, and export the data to PNG and CSV.

Share cards. Share a measurement or an animal's profile as a good-looking picture.

Plus bug fixes and stability.
